concepts.title: Custom Embroidered Dice Tower Crest Tee, Personalized Tabletop RPG Gift, Your Table Name Stitched, Comfort Colors Game Night Shirt
concepts.description:
This design was created by me using AI image-generation tools as part of my design process, then refined and prepared for print by hand.

A stone dice tower crowned as a guild badge, with your table's name stitched into the ribbon.

Stitched, not printed. Real embroidery thread on the left chest, so the badge has actual relief you can feel and nothing to crack, peel or fade in the wash.

- Comfort Colors 1717, garment-dyed heavyweight cotton
- Unisex relaxed fit, S-4XL
- Made to order and shipped from the USA, tracked on every order

Fewer than 1% of customers ever use our 30-day return, but it is there.
